thread:
anna-partnerships: Quick sync — we need a concise playbook for SI co-sell handoffs covering cloud marketplace, hardware partner bundles, and joint announcements. Goal: clear ownership, SLA, and SFDC tagging. Who can help define routing + rules of engagement?

mike-sales: I can help. key constraints: territory vs named accounts, inbound marketplace leads, and partner-sourced opps. Need mapping spreadsheet.

sam-se: From SE side — we also need a lightweight tech-qualification checklist so AEs don't send unqualified leads to SIs. 3 bullets: infra fit, data residency, SLA tier.

josh-si-partner: +1. For SIs we need a claim window. Our preference: partner portal claim within 48h, else revert to Redwood AE. Also must be CC'd on initial outreach.

rebecca-gm: Important: deal registration + commission tier must be enforced. If partner claims and registers in SFDC, they get co-sell status; otherwise standard routing. Also need one canonical account mapping doc (region, org owner, partner coverage).

anna-partnerships: Drafting suggested flow below — please poke holes.

anna-partnerships: ```Handoff play (proposal):
1) Inbound marketplace leads: auto-create lead in SFDC with tag = marketplace. Notify partner portal if partner mapping exists. Partner has 24h to claim in portal. If claimed -> partner owns lead, Redwood provides AE/SE support. If unclaimed -> Redwood AE triages.
2) Partner-sourced leads: partner registers deal in SFDC -> partner owns pre-sales. Redwood AE/SE assigned as technical co-sell.
3) Named accounts: territory owner (AE) retains ownership; partner can be engaged via partner engagement request.
4) Hardware-bundle deals: require joint-attestation doc + PO flow; escalate to partnerships for pricing exceptions.
SLA: partner claim response 24-48h depending on source. Initial outreach within 48h.
```

mike-sales: That looks good. For marketplace leads 24h might be tight during EMEA off-hours — recommend 48h globally, with 24h for US/PST priority customers.

sam-se: Agreed on 48h for global. Also add a short SE checklist to the SFDC lead form: expected QPS, data residency, model size, on-prem vs VPC.

josh-si-partner: Can we include a simple template email for partners to use when claiming? reduces back-and-forth.

anna-partnerships: I'll add a claim-email template. Also propose these routing tags in SFDC: source=marketplace|partner|outbound; partner_claimed=true/false; partner_name=<text>; si_co_sell_status=registered|unregistered.

rebecca-gm: Ops note — we must track revenue crediting rules in the mapping doc. Partnerships + Rev Ops to own final mapping. Ops: please surface edge cases (multi-region accounts, overlapping partner coverage).

deploybot: Created task PRT-482 in Partnerships board: "SI co-sell routing + handoff playbook" assigned to anna-partnerships, due in 7 days.

anna-partnerships: Action items: (1) I’ll update the doc with 48h claim SLA + email template (2) mike to share account mapping spreadsheet sample (3) sam to draft SE checklist fields for SFDC (4) rebecca + revops to confirm crediting rules. Link: https://redwood.zoom/drive/si-co-sell-playbook-draft (working doc).

mike-sales: Sharing sample mapping now.

sam-se: Will add checklist by EOD tomorrow.

josh-si-partner: Thanks — partner side happy to pilot on 2 deals next week.

anna-partnerships: Perfect — will circulate v0.1 after edits. :thumbsup:
